_doc: Every deliberate pin in this repo. Read the `pins` skill before editing. A pin must have a reason, a review deadline within max_review_days of the last review, and a probe or a manual_test. Moving review_by forward means you re-tested it and wrote down what you found in `review_note`.

pins.reason: On nixpkgs_unstable from 02c087f3 (2026-10-23) Ghidra's native decompile helper segfaults on startup (exit 139), so rea-ghidra fails and every nightly lock PR is blocked. Bisected to the nixpkgs_unstable bump alone; Ghidra, JDK and rea versions are unchanged. Not a Ghidra version problem: 12.1.2 fails on the new rev, 12.1.4 passes on the old one.
pins.removal: Delete the input, the rea-toolchain attribute in overlays/default.nix, and point home/programs/rea/ghidra.nix back at pkgs.unstable. Or move the rev forward if a newer rev passes.
pins.upstream: https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs (no issue filed yet; file one with the glibc 2.44-57 segfault)

pins.reason: Pinned in 69fc7338 'until amdgpu bugs fixed in latest kernels'. Nothing records which bugs or which kernel fixes them, and it is 10 months old.
pins.removal: Find which hosts use lqx_pin (pkgs.lqx_pin), boot the current kernel there and drop the input if the amdgpu bugs are gone.
pins.manual_test: On the affected host, switch the kernel to the current lqx/zen kernel from nixpkgs_unstable, run a GPU-heavy session for a day, and check dmesg for amdgpu errors.

pins.reason: Kept as a rev pin, not branch-following, so a kernel bump is a reviewed change and the CI builder builds and caches the LTO kernel before it reaches a host. Upstream's `release` branch has been frozen since 2026-09-28, so the pin tracks `master`.
pins.removal: Bump to the current upstream master rev when the probe says one exists.

pins.reason: Must match the niks3 server running in aws-k3s. Server v1.6.1 switched small NARs to single-PUT presigned URLs; clients older than 1.6.1 reject that with 'NAR files should use multipart upload'. Client and server API drift gives 404s.
pins.removal: Bump together with the aws-k3s niks3 server image (home-cluster repo), never alone.

pins.reason: Version selected when the repo moved to the dendritic layout (13982132). A tagged release is a deliberate choice, not a workaround; the registry entry exists so it is reviewed on a schedule.
pins.removal: Bump when a newer release exists and `just check` passes.

pins.reason: Pinned to the v0.6.0 release in 420737e3 ('Fix KVM VMs'). The commit does not say why a later release is unsuitable, so treat this as unverified until someone tries.
pins.removal: Bump when a newer release exists and the KVM hypervisor host still builds.

pins.reason: UNDOCUMENTED. Pinned to a rev of the owner's own repo in 92adf802 ('upgrade tmux-sessionizer'); no reason recorded for not following the branch.
pins.removal: Change the url to github:alisonjenkins/tmux-sessionizer (branch), lock, and build a host that uses it.
pins.manual_test: Follow the branch and `just build` ali-mba-linux or ali-work-laptop, which import it.

pins.pinned: pnpm-10.29.2 permitted as insecure (also in ali-mba and ali-work-laptop-macos)
pins.reason: signal-desktop's build needs pnpm 10.29.2, which nixpkgs flags knownVulnerabilities. It is a build-time tool and the only pnpm consumer in the closures (vesktop was dropped for the same reason). Scoping the permit per consumer is not expressible here.
pins.removal: Remove the permit once nixpkgs ships a non-flagged pnpm for signal. Check: nix-store -q --requisites <toplevel.drv> | grep pnpm. Remove it from all three files.
pins.manual_test: Delete the permit from modules/base/default.nix and evaluate a desktop host's toplevel; if it evaluates, repeat for the two darwin hosts and delete the entry.

pins.pinned: pnpm-9.15.9 permitted as insecure on ali-steam-deck
pins.reason: Jovian's decky-loader build pins pnpm 9.15.9, flagged insecure in nixpkgs 26.11, to assemble Decky's static frontend. Build-time only, runs in the sandbox, never in the runtime closure.
pins.removal: Remove when Jovian's decky-loader moves to a supported pnpm (jovian-nixos input).
pins.manual_test: Delete the permit and evaluate nixosConfigurations.ali-steam-deck; if it evaluates, delete this entry.

pins.pinned: FFmpeg master 19c06936 (2026-10-23) used for citron and zen-browser
pins.reason: No ffmpeg release has the fixes for the CVEs vulnix reports on 9.0.2 and 8.1.x: the NVD texts read "through 9.0.2" and "before 9.0", and the five fix commits they cite (4da9812, 5d7112c, 8670835, aafb5c6, b506faf) are in master but in no release. blender (5.1.1, ffmpeg 7), makemkv (2.0.0, ffmpeg 8) and lutris (FHS ffmpeg 6) cannot take master: it removed AVCodec::sample_fmts, ch_layouts and supported_samplerates, which blender's audaspace and makemkv's libffabi use, so they stay on vulnerable releases.
pins.removal: Delete pkgs/ffmpeg-git, the ffmpeg-git and ffmpeg-git-unstable entries in pkgs/default.nix, the citron ffmpeg argument and the zen-browser unwrappedPackage override, then rescan with vulnix -C.
